Now you can use the new `save_client_config` method to download a client configuration and save it as `client_config.yaml` in your current directory. Here's an example of how to use it:

```python
from leanworks.data.github import GitHub
from your_secret_client import SecretClient  # Replace with your actual secret client

# Initialize your secret client
secret_client = SecretClient()

# Initialize GitHub client
github = GitHub(secret_client)

# Download and save client config
file_path = github.save_client_config("client_name")  # Replace with actual client name
print(f"Client configuration saved to: {file_path}")
```

Replace "client_name" with the actual name of the client whose configuration you want to download. The file will be saved as "client_config.yaml" in your current directory by default, but you can specify a different path if needed.
